concerns.text: Success Criterion SC‑005 (imputation sensitivity analysis reporting absolute change > 0.02 triggers a warning) is not referenced or addressed in the plan. The plan mentions a K‑NN‑imputation sensitivity branch but does not specify the required reporting or warning logic.
The plan includes an 'α‑sensitivity sweep (α = 0.01, 0.05, 0.10)' which is not present in the specification. This constitutes over‑reach beyond the defined FR/SC set.
